PluginData.Author: Viktor, Space
PluginData.Tooltip: Toggleable helmet night vision with passive vision through glass.
PluginData.Description:
Adds a night vision mode in the style of Elite Dangerous: amplified green luminance with thin outlines on silhouettes, grain and a vignette.
A closed helmet provides full night vision. With the helmet open, passive night vision is applied only through glass materials.
Hold the light key (L) to toggle it; a tap still toggles the light. While active, the night vision icon replaces the current HUD's light icon.
Purely local visual effect, nothing is synced.
